slides.speaker_notes: V4.1 Minor Revision: the author-lab image labels the last band subgraph as the Nth band; this explanatory redraw uses B_N with uppercase N to distinguish the index from lowercase n. Band-pass filtering yields signals in each frequency band; graph construction then builds one subgraph per band and connects the subgraphs into the total graph. The Total graph shows B₁, B₂, B₃ and B_N as representative rows; the vertical ellipsis and non-attached dashed continuation rail indicate omitted intermediate bands and deliberately do not assert a B₃-to-B_N node edge. One dashed inter-band connector is a schematic example only. The five output markers are near-square and illustrative, labelled Fault classification. Keep a single IR/SR terminology note in the Evidence boundary; author-lab artwork says IR layer, while the published abstract says sensitivity-aware readout (SR), and the correspondence remains unresolved. The OCF Before/After waveforms are illustrative, not measured.

slides.claim: The redraw preserves method topology while leaving numerical adjacency unasserted.
slides.speaker_notes: The v7.5 composite has 18 source-visible directed routes checked against the publisher graphical abstract: five in the frequency-band panel, one Total graph-to-Input connection, and twelve in the SEANet diagnosis panel. The redraw uses vector sensor stand-ins and schematic graph coordinates; it does not claim a numerical adjacency matrix. CI verifies editable objects, route geometry, labels and rendering, but does not establish independent scientific approval, real projection/final-size readability, or a PowerPoint 2016 host round trip. These three checks remain open.
